description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.

                  id="Definitions_SupplierSelection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateTerms" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgreeTerms" name="Agree on contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" name="Onboard supplier and execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin" name="Onboarding and contract execution complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Supplier officially onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentDone" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
